# Error reporting with Sentry (block: sentry)

Report unhandled errors (5xx) and failed background work to Sentry without the SDK: stack frames, route, user id, breadcrumbs from the request's logs, release and environment. Secrets are scrubbed, 4xx ignored, bursts deduplicated, sampling and a per minute cap.

The code is in `app/blocks/sentry/` and belongs to this project. Options go in `calm.config.js` under `blocks['sentry']`; secrets go in `.env`.

## For AI agents

- Read `app/blocks/sentry/index.js` (capture rules, the log sink) and `event.js` (DSN, stack frames, scrubbing, envelope) before changing anything.
- Errors reach Sentry through the logger: the core error handler logs 5xx with `log.error(msg, { err })` after setting `req.calmError`. Do not add try/catch blocks that swallow errors to report them; let them throw.
- Invariant: 4xx are never reported, and nothing leaves the server unscrubbed. Every new field added to an event must go through `scrub()` or `scrubString()`.
- Invariant: only the user id is sent by default. Email (`sendUserEmail`), IP (`sendIp`) and request bodies (`sendBody`) are opt-in options; do not turn them on without the user asking.
- Add keys to scrub with the `sensitiveKeys` option in calm.config.js rather than editing the built-in list.
- Report handled problems with `ctx.app.ext.sentry.captureException(err, { tags, extra })` or `captureMessage(text, { level })`; both return the event id or null.
- `SENTRY_DSN` lives in `.env`. The DSN's public key is not a secret, but keep it out of git anyway.
- Inside this block, log failures with `log.warn` and never with an `err` field at error level: the sink would report its own failures in a loop.
- Noise control lives in `admit()`: dedupe window, per minute cap, sample rate, and a pause after Sentry answers 429. Keep it in front of every send.
- Tests point `SENTRY_DSN` at a local node:http server (http://key@127.0.0.1:port/42) and read the envelopes it receives.

## Official documentation

- [Sentry envelopes](https://develop.sentry.dev/sdk/data-model/envelopes/)
- [Sentry event payloads](https://develop.sentry.dev/sdk/data-model/event-payloads/)
- [Sentry SDK overview (authentication, DSN)](https://develop.sentry.dev/sdk/overview/)
- [Data Source Name (DSN)](https://docs.sentry.io/concepts/key-terms/dsn-explainer/)
- [Scrubbing sensitive data](https://docs.sentry.io/security-legal-pii/scrubbing/)

## Usage

Set SENTRY_DSN (Sentry: Project settings, Client Keys (DSN)). Every 5xx is then reported with its stack, route, URL (query secrets filtered), user id and the request's log lines; 4xx are not.
Failed background tasks and event listeners are reported too. Report your own: ctx.app.ext.sentry.captureException(err, { tags, extra }) or captureMessage(text, { level }).
Options in calm.config.js: blocks: { sentry: { sampleRate, dedupeSeconds, maxEventsPerMinute, sendUserEmail, sendIp, sendBody, sensitiveKeys, ignoreErrors, beforeSend } }

## Environment variables

- `SENTRY_DSN`
- `SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT`
- `SENTRY_RELEASE`

More: https://docs.calmapi.dev/blocks/sentry
